deadline.value: Applicants who need a UK visa must apply by 2 August 2027 for a September or October 2027 start. The page gives no earlier funding deadline.
deadline.quote: For research courses that start in September and October 2027, the application deadline for students who require a visa to study in the UK is 2 August 2027.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Find a supervisor from the Warwick Medical School approved list and discuss your area with them before applying.
supervisor.quote: Find your supervisor using the link below and discuss with them the area you'd like to research.

funding.value: The course page only points to general scholarship information.

entry_route.value: A 2:1 undergraduate degree or a Merit in a Master's degree is accepted.
entry_route.quote: 2:1 undergraduate degree or Merit in Master’s degree.

ielts_min.value: The medical school sets its IELTS band by course title: Band A (6.5) or Band B (7.0). Check the course title.

toefl_min.value: The medical school sets its TOEFL band by course title (Band A or Band B), so check the course title.

notes: Warwick Medical School course page lists Band A and Band B English requirements, depending on the course title. Course codes differ by title (for example Medical Sciences P-A34P, Health Sciences P-B91P).
